Try scanner

AI

MCP works because the ledger is item-level.

Trezzit does not expose a chatbot over vague transaction blobs. It exposes MCP tools over item shares, bill items, group balances, and settlements, so an agent can cite the exact rows behind an answer.

Protocol

JSON-RPC tools, OAuth 2.1 scopes.

The server is backend-only and provider-agnostic. Clients call tools/list and tools/call over JSON-RPC after OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; bills:read and bills:write scopes keep query access separate from mutations.

tools/list
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "tools/list",
  "params": {},
  "id": 1
}
tools/call
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "get_expenses",
    "arguments": {
      "group_id": "cabin-trip",
      "category": "Food",
      "date_from": "2026-05-01",
      "date_to": "2026-05-31"
    }
  },
  "id": 7
}

Inventory

The 13 tools.

Tool Scope What it gives the agent
get_context Read Current user, available groups, and server capability context.
list_groups Read Groups the authorized person can inspect.
get_group_details Read Group members, currency, balances, and metadata.
search_bills Read Bill search across merchant names, descriptions, and dates.
get_bill_details Read Line items, participants, item shares, and audit-friendly bill detail.
get_balances Read Who owes whom inside the authorized group context.
get_expenses Read Item-share expense rows filtered by dates, groups, categories, tags, and search.
get_person_info Read Person records needed to resolve bill participants.
resolve_participants Read Name matching before a create_bill mutation.
get_receipt_upload_presigned_url Read Upload preparation for receipt bytes before bill creation.
create_bill Write Creates an attributed bill from structured bill and item-share data.
delete_bill Write Deletes an AI-created bill only inside the allowed mutation window.
create_settlement Write Records a settlement payment between people.

Scopes

Read and write are separate decisions.

A read-only client can inspect groups, bills, balances, expenses, people, and receipt-upload preparation. A write-scoped client can create bills, delete eligible AI-created bills, and create settlements.

bills:read

Search bills, inspect balances, resolve people, and query item-share expenses.

bills:write

Create attributed bills and settlements with per-session write limits.

mutation window

AI-created bills can be edited or deleted by the agent only inside the 30-minute window.

Clients

Works with MCP-capable clients.

Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini-compatible clients, and any client that speaks MCP can connect to the same tool surface. Trezzit does not require a provider-specific integration.

An itemized ledger for shared expenses. Split receipts, preserve item shares, and let AI answer from the same rows the app uses.
